Material Info The Resource Group International Limited (TRGI) has informed TRG Pakistan Ltd. that the TRGI Board has approved the allocation of its liquid assets to its shareholders. TRG Pakistan portion of the liquid assets would be approximately USD 120 million (inclusive of approximately USD 10 million in deferred cash) plus approximately 5.4 million shares of its listed portfolio company, Ibex Limited. The process and structure for utilization of the above allocation is expected to be finalized by 31 December 2021, and TRG Pakistan will announce further details at that time.

Mr. Chishti has also resigned from his positions at The Resource Group Internati

Material Info It has been noticed that there has been a significant shift in the share price of TRG Pakistan Limited (TRGP) over the last few days. At this point in time, it may be noted that TRGP is pleased to report that there is no change to report in our forecasts for our portfolio companies where revenues appear stable. TRGP will continue to provide updates as appropriate.

Material Info In accordance with Paragraph 5.6.2 of the Rule Book of the Pakistan Stock Exchange Limited, we hereby convey the following:  It has come to the attention of the Company that there are various articles being circulated in the electronic media in relation to the CEO of the Company, which is potentially affecting the market price of the Company.   While we understand that the CEO of the Company strongly disputes the accusations levelled against him, the matter involves the laws and procedures of a foreign jurisdiction and not of Pakistan.   As such, as and when the Company is made aware of any material development on the matter, the shareholders shall be informed accordingly.
